# n3 - The roadmap file writer

`RoadmapRender.write(path, renamer:)` renders `## Tree` and the file's own grouping section from
the model and writes them back through `AtomicWrite`, replacing exactly those two sections and
leaving every other byte of the file alone. Entry lines are carried over verbatim, and so are the
lines the canonical grammar cannot parse and the prose a human wrote between batch headings. A
legacy `## Waves` roadmap renders into that heading in place. A cyclic graph is refused, not
written.

## n3 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3.1 | Replace `## Tree`, creating it when absent | A second render appends a second `## Tree` instead of replacing the first, and the file grows a new tree on every run | `roadmap_render_test#test_second_render_replaces_the_tree_and_does_not_append` |
| 3.2 | Regroup entries into computed batches | The regroup rewrites entry lines from parsed fields, and a title, a status token, or a trailing parenthetical is silently lost from the roadmap | `roadmap_render_test#test_entry_lines_are_carried_over_verbatim_into_computed_batches` |
| 3.3 | Leave `## Goal`, `## Graph`, and `## Log` byte-identical | A render eats the append-only Log or reflows the human's Goal, destroying the only narrative record the roadmap has | `roadmap_render_test#test_goal_graph_and_log_sections_are_byte_identical_after_render` |
| 3.4 | Write through `AtomicWrite` | An in-place truncate loses the whole roadmap when the process dies mid-write, which is the failure C5 exists to prevent | `roadmap_render_test#test_write_goes_through_atomic_write_not_file_write` |
| 3.5 | Survive a rename that raises | A failed rename leaves the roadmap empty or half written and leaves a temp file behind for the store's auto-commit to sweep in | `roadmap_render_test#test_failed_rename_leaves_the_original_intact_and_no_temp_behind` |
| 3.6 | Refuse a cyclic graph | The writer commits a partial or invented order to disk, making a human edit error permanent and authoritative | `roadmap_render_test#test_cyclic_graph_is_refused_and_the_file_is_unchanged` |
| 3.7 | Preserve a legacy `## Waves` heading | The writer renames `## Waves` to `## Batches` on the seven live pre-ruling roadmaps, which owner ruling 145 forbids | `roadmap_render_test#test_legacy_waves_heading_is_preserved_not_renamed` |
| 3.8 | Refuse a roadmap with no `## Graph` | The writer invents batches for a graphless roadmap and overwrites the human's hand order with a guess | `roadmap_render_test#test_roadmap_without_graph_is_refused_and_unchanged` |
| 3.9 | Render idempotently | Running the render twice changes bytes the second time, so no caller can tell a real change from render churn | `roadmap_render_test#test_render_twice_changes_no_bytes_the_second_time` |
| 3.10 | Keep an entry the graph does not name | A partly migrated roadmap loses its unnamed entries at the first render, which is data loss disguised as a computation | `roadmap_render_test#test_entry_absent_from_graph_survives_the_render_in_the_first_batch` |
| 3.11 | Preserve the file's trailing newline convention | Every render flips the final newline and every roadmap shows a one-line diff forever | `roadmap_render_test#test_trailing_newline_is_preserved` |
| 3.12 | Report what changed without writing when asked | A dry run writes anyway, so the safe way to inspect a migration is not safe | `roadmap_render_test#test_dry_run_returns_the_new_content_and_writes_nothing` |
| 3.13 | Carry non-entry prose inside the grouping section through the regroup | Folded at review (A1): `graph-ready-plastic.md` keeps its five-line intro and the two-paragraph 327 D43 kill-gate record inside `## Batches`, between two batch headings, and that ratification lives nowhere else. A regroup that rebuilds the section from parsed entries deletes it | `roadmap_render_test#test_non_entry_prose_survives_the_regroup_anchored_to_its_batch_heading` |
| 3.14 | Carry an entry line the canonical grammar cannot parse | Folded at review (A2): 21 human-visible entry lines across 5 live roadmaps do not match `RoadmapQueue::ENTRY`, including one shaped `- (not filed) 2a Shell page build` and ten more on `standalone-agent.md`. A regroup built from parsed entries deletes all 21 | `roadmap_render_test#test_unparseable_entry_line_is_carried_verbatim_into_the_batch_its_position_implies` |
| 3.15 | Render a legacy `## Waves` roadmap into that heading in place | Folded at review (A3, D12): adding a `## Batches` section beside `## Waves` repoints `RoadmapSavepoint.grouping_heading`, and with it every reader, at the generated section and orphans the section the human wrote. Seven live roadmaps use `## Waves` | `roadmap_render_test#test_waves_roadmap_renders_into_waves_and_never_gains_a_batches_heading` |

## Steps
1. Red: the matrix's tests above, committed before any code in this node.
2. Write the code that makes them pass.
3. Green, then `ruby bin/test` at its baseline before the next node starts.
